IC1.IC1.1: Diagnosis reviewed at transplant center and confirmed to fit the criterion for high risk blood disease or cancer, as defined for the study

IC2.IC2.1: Estimated life expectancy of at least 6 weeks following study entry

IC3.IC3.1: Cancer and Leukemia Group B (CALGB) performance status less than or equal to 2

IC4.IC4.1: White blood cell count, platelet, hematocrit, tuberculosis, aspartate aminotransferase (AST), alanine aminotransferase (ALT), alkaline phosphatase, creatinine, and HIV test results reviewed by transplant center

IC5.IC5.1: Multiple gated acquisition (MUGA), echocardiogram, cardiac MRI, and/or pulmonary function tests (PFT) performed and reviewed by transplant center
IC5.IC5.2: (for individuals with an ejection fraction and diffusing capacity [DLCO] of 40-50%, the appropriate cardiology or pulmonary consultations should be considered if the individual has severe heart or lung disease at the initiation of therapy)

IC6.IC6.1: Sufficient number of umbilical cord blood units available for transplantation

IC7.IC7.1: If female, willing to use contraception throughout the study

EC1.EC1.1: Undergoing Interleukin-2 (IL-2) therapy within 8 weeks of study entry

EC2.EC2.1: Diagnosed with a medical or psychiatric illness that may interfere with study participation
